meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug 整理成详细的 GitHub issue 或 PR，包含复现步骤、根因分析和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或处理 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我报告一个 LazyCodex 安装失败的 bug。
say.note: Claude 会调查并创建 issue。

say.text: 给 openai/codex 提一个 PR 修复这个 bug。
say.note: 仅当 bug 在纯净 Codex 中复现时才会创建 PR。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you turn a LazyCodex or Codex bug into a detailed GitHub issue or PR, including reproduction steps, root cause analysis, and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a bug related to LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI.

say_en.text: Report a bug about LazyCodex installation failure.
say_en.note: Claude will investigate and create an issue.

say_en.text: Create a PR for openai/codex to fix this bug.
say_en.note: Only creates a PR if the bug reproduces in clean upstream Codex.
